description: BIGVILLE R4 (block 252000) -- store hours as an EXPECTATION (predict-and-residual, NOT a law). The town HOLDS a prediction 'the stall opens at 8' as an `Expect{open_due}` held by would-be customers (`expects` -> Expect -about_shop-> Shop). When the scheduled open moment arrives (open_due=1, written mechanically from the R3 clock) but the stall is SHUT (open=0, e.g. a keeper who COLLAPSED overnight per be_shop_shut), `be_expect_surprise` registers a SURPRISE -- a `Surprise{residual}` node the customer is `surprised` about -- the substrate's predict-and-residual loop ([[ozma_held_prediction_decay]]) at the SOCIAL level, deduped per shop (surprised_done). This is a DIFFERENT normative register from a LAW violation (block 247000): a law violation draws CENSURE (enforced); an expectation violation is SURPRISE (predicted, not enforced) + a downstream supply gap. This seed touches NO enforcement/censure rule -- the two registers stay distinct (source-audited). Keeper opens on time (open=1) -> no surprise. Composes existing Terms; zero new Rust.
